prerequisites: No prerequisites. Competences taught in the modules 'Introduction to Bioinformatics' and 'Fundamentals of Statistics' are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: Students can explain the most important methods from statistical bioinformatics that are necessary for calculations in the scientific field.
Students are able to select, perform, and implement suitable procedures for specific case studies.

syllabus_topics: Selected topics from statistical bioinformatics required for calculations in the scientific field, especially from biological data processing (e.g., alignments, encoding)
Methods from statistics (e.g., statistical tests, evaluation)
Methods from statistical learning (e.g., Random Forests)

assessment_methods.method: Oral presentation of solutions to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from the weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and the solution to at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. The examination performance consists of either an oral examination or a written examination. Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
bibliography: Witten, Frank und Hall: Data Mining, Morgan Kaufmann
Further literature will be announced during the course.
